frozen: nightwatch/journal/adjust.py (tail factors, horizon bands, the narrow-window margin, MIN_BAND_N, refit cadence, K clamps)
the analog search that produces the p5 to p95 forecast it adjusts
note: The adjustment was designed and tuned by looking at the 2,302 replayed forecasts it is also scored on, so the headline breach rate on that history is optimistic by an unknown amount. Forecasts whose as-of time is on or after frozen_at were made after the method was fixed and could not have influenced it. Their result is the out-of-sample one.
